request: In Calamaio, C-c k (ctrl+c k) should show in the echo area "Last kill: " and the newest text of the kill ring, or "Kill ring is empty" when nothing was killed yet. Write it as a command show-last-kill and its key, in Lisp, in the program's killring.lisp.

reference.message: C-c k shows the last kill

add./program/killring.lisp/show-last-kill:
(defcommand show-last-kill "Shows the newest kill in the echo area." :title "Show Last Kill" :category "Killing"
  []
  (if (empty? state.kills)
    (message "Kill ring is empty")
    (message (str "Last kill: " (first state.kills)))))
